15/G.goal: Explain the main categories of AR hardware, including their components, examples, operation, application domains, and relevant open issues, and distinguish AR headsets from VR headsets.
15/G.achieves: It equips the learner with foundational AR hardware knowledge for understanding and evaluating AR systems, supporting the course aim of understanding and implementing an XR system with confidence.

15/O1.goal: Describe the main categories of AR hardware, explaining their components, examples, interaction or display operation, application domains, and relevant open issues.
15/O1.achieves: It gives the learner a practical hardware framework for recognizing AR system types and for understanding the hardware constraints that affect later XR system design and implementation.
